name: Westfield Culver City
summary: Westfield Culver City is a vibrant multi-level regional mall in the heart of Culver City, featuring major anchors like Macy's, Target, and JCPenney alongside popular retailers including Sephora, UNIQLO, and Best Buy. The center offers diverse dining options, innovative entertainment with Activate gaming facility, and modern amenities including EV charging and free Wi-Fi.
demographics: Westfield Culver City attracts a diverse, affluent demographic from the Westside Los Angeles area, including Culver City, West Los Angeles, and nearby communities. The primary visitor base consists of middle to upper-middle income households with ages ranging from 25-54, including young professionals, families, and entertainment industry workers drawn to the area's proximity to major studios. The trade area benefits from high household incomes, strong educational attainment, and a tech-savvy population that values both convenience and experiential retail. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for omnichannel experiences, with visitors seeking a mix of fashion, dining, entertainment, and services in a single destination.
description: Westfield Culver City is a premier shopping destination located at 6000 Sepulveda Boulevard in the heart of Culver City, California. This multi-level regional mall offers an exceptional retail experience with major anchor stores including Macy's, JCPenney, and Target, complemented by popular retailers such as H&M, UNIQLO, Sephora, Ulta Beauty, and Best Buy. The center features a diverse mix of fashion brands from Foot Locker and JD Sports to Hollister Co. and Garage, alongside specialty stores like Build-A-Bear Workshop, Miniso, and POP MART. Dining options range from casual eateries like BJ's Restaurant & Brewhouse and California Fish Grill to the dining terrace featuring Massis Kabob, providing visitors with varied culinary experiences. The mall also offers unique entertainment with Activate, the world's first active gaming facility featuring interactive tech-driven game rooms, as well as convenient services including free Wi-Fi, electric vehicle charging stations, and secure locker facilities for shoppers' convenience.
